import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.GlueDescent

/-!
# Uniqueness of finite locally free rank

Two finite locally free ranks of the same module agree on a nonempty scheme.
Consequently an epimorphism between locally free modules of different ranks
has nonzero kernel. This is the rank input for selecting a nonzero section
in the kernel of a Grassmannian quotient.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits
open AlgebraicGeometry

noncomputable section

namespace AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules

private def restrictFreeIso {X : Scheme.{u}} {M : X.Modules} {r : ℕ}
    {W U : X.Opens} (h : W ≤ U)
    (e : (pullback U.ι).obj M ≅
      SheafOfModules.free (R := U.toScheme.ringCatSheaf) (ULift.{u} (Fin r))) :
    (pullback W.ι).obj M ≅
      SheafOfModules.free (R := W.toScheme.ringCatSheaf) (ULift.{u} (Fin r)) :=
  (pullbackCongr (X.homOfLE_ι h).symm).app M ≪≫
    ((pullbackComp (X.homOfLE h) U.ι).app M).symm ≪≫
    (pullback (X.homOfLE h)).mapIso e ≪≫
    pullbackFreeIso (X.homOfLE h) (ULift.{u} (Fin r))

/-- The finite locally free rank of a module is unique as soon as the base
has a point. -/
theorem rank_eq_of_isLocallyFreeOfRank
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {M : X.Modules} {r d : ℕ}
    (hr : SheafOfModules.IsLocallyFreeOfRank M r)
    (hd : SheafOfModules.IsLocallyFreeOfRank M d) (x : X) : r = d := by
  obtain ⟨I, U, hU, eU⟩ := hr
  obtain ⟨J, V, hV, eV⟩ := hd
  have hxU : x ∈ ⨆ i, U i := by rw [hU]; trivial
  have hxV : x ∈ ⨆ j, V j := by rw [hV]; trivial
  obtain ⟨i, hxi⟩ := TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.mp hxU
  obtain ⟨j, hxj⟩ := TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.mp hxV
  obtain ⟨W, hW, hxW, hWle⟩ :=
    exists_isAffineOpen_mem_and_subset (x := x) (U := U i ⊓ V j) ⟨hxi, hxj⟩
  letI : IsAffine W.toScheme := hW
  letI : Nonempty (⊤ : W.toScheme.Opens) := ⟨⟨⟨x, hxW⟩, trivial⟩⟩
  let R := Γ(W.toScheme, ⊤)
  let e : SheafOfModules.free (R := W.toScheme.ringCatSheaf) (ULift.{u} (Fin r)) ≅
      SheafOfModules.free (R := W.toScheme.ringCatSheaf) (ULift.{u} (Fin d)) :=
    (restrictFreeIso (hWle.trans inf_le_left) (eU i).some).symm ≪≫
      restrictFreeIso (hWle.trans inf_le_right) (eV j).some
  let eSpec : SheafOfModules.free (R := (Spec R).ringCatSheaf) (ULift.{u} (Fin r)) ≅
      SheafOfModules.free (R := (Spec R).ringCatSheaf) (ULift.{u} (Fin d)) :=
    (pullbackFreeIso W.toScheme.isoSpec.inv (ULift.{u} (Fin r))).symm ≪≫
      (pullback W.toScheme.isoSpec.inv).mapIso e ≪≫
      pullbackFreeIso W.toScheme.isoSpec.inv (ULift.{u} (Fin d))
  let eModule : ModuleCat.of R (ULift.{u} (Fin r) →₀ R) ≅
      ModuleCat.of R (ULift.{u} (Fin d) →₀ R) :=
    tilde.fullyFaithfulFunctor.preimageIso
      (tildeFinsupp (ULift.{u} (Fin r)) ≪≫ eSpec ≪≫
        (tildeFinsupp (ULift.{u} (Fin d))).symm)
  simpa only [Module.finrank_finsupp_self, Fintype.card_ulift, Fintype.card_fin]
    using eModule.toLinearEquiv.finrank_eq

/-- An epimorphism between locally free modules of distinct finite ranks
cannot have zero kernel on a nonempty scheme. -/
theorem not_isZero_kernel_of_locallyFree_rank_ne
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {M N : X.Modules} {r d : ℕ}
    (hM : SheafOfModules.IsLocallyFreeOfRank M r)
    (hN : SheafOfModules.IsLocallyFreeOfRank N d)
    (hrd : r ≠ d) (x : X) (q : M ⟶ N) [Epi q] :
    ¬ IsZero (kernel q) := by
  intro hzero
  haveI : Mono q := Abelian.mono_of_kernel_ι_eq_zero q (hzero.eq_of_src _ _)
  haveI : IsIso q := isIso_of_mono_of_epi q
  obtain ⟨I, U, hU, eU⟩ := hN
  have hMd : SheafOfModules.IsLocallyFreeOfRank M d :=
    ⟨I, U, hU, fun i => ⟨(pullback (U i).ι).mapIso (asIso q) ≪≫ (eU i).some⟩⟩
  exact hrd (rank_eq_of_isLocallyFreeOfRank hM hMd x)

end AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules
